apps.name: Playd
apps.subtitle: Track your gaming journey
apps.localizedDescription: Playd is your personal game tracker. Add games from IGDB, track what you're playing, manage your backlog, and sync your library with Playd Cloud.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Playd finds your PC on the local network to sync your library, lists, notes, and playtime, and, when you turn on PC Remote, to control that PC.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Playd may use the camera for future features.

versions.localizedDescription: Universal Clipboard shares a copy between iPhone and Playd on Windows until you copy something else. Play launches the game instead of a checksum tool or DirectX setup, on-screen playtime is in minutes, and saved artwork stays put. Update the Windows companion too.

Game detail sheets now fill the top banner edge-to-edge and dismiss by swiping down, Discover covers trim framed borders cleanly with rounded corners, and PC Remote connects faster with reliable signaling retries. Update the Windows companion too.
Game details now show Metacritic scores by platform and improved artwork. This update also improves cloud sync, saved-game matching, and PC Remote reliability. Update the Windows companion too.

Discover, game search, game details, screenshots, and store links now run on IGDB with Steam Metascore enrichment, replacing RAWG. Existing library items keep their history, playtime, ratings, and lists. Update the Windows companion too.

Watch another PC live from the iPhone or a second Windows copy on the same account. The pointer follows your movement, and remote pictures are no longer stored in the cloud. Update the Windows companion too.
Safer backup restores and playtime recovery, corrected CSV import and undo, and more reliable remote controls. Faster large libraries and assistant preparation. Update the Windows companion too.

Redesigned rating controls with thicker tracks, cleaner markers, 0.1 steps, and automatic saving. Windows screenshots stay stable while rating. Safer Playd Cloud upgrades and pending LAN sync recovery. Update the Windows companion too.
Zoom and pan directly on the PC monitor image. Zooming requests sharper frames, up to 4K, with improved text detail and live preview delivery. Update the Windows companion too.
Live away-from-home PC remote, a rating control that saves as you move it, scheduled hibernate that still happens if you close Playd, and faster library screens.
Portable Windows updater repair, reliable library and playtime sync, remote command recovery, iPad backup sharing, and desktop responsiveness.

🔄 Offline Sync Fix

• Games played while app is offline now properly added to Playing
• Playtime minutes are now tracked and accumulated
• Fixed mid-game detection when opening app
• All game statuses properly handled

🔔 Custom Notifications (iOS)

• Added support for Bark notifications
• Game covers now appear in notifications!
• Minor stability improvements

🔧 Bug Fixes

• Fixed Alan Wake II crack status detection (Roman numerals now properly converted)
• Reverted hero animation that caused image display issues
• Improved PreDB search matching for games with sequel numbers

🔧 Bug Fixes

• Fixed inaccurate list counts (stale UUIDs cleaned up)
• Tracked games now properly deleted when removed from all lists
• Screenshot gallery now has smooth hero zoom animation
• Various stability improvements

🔵 Circular Liquid Glass Buttons

• Fixed buttons to be circular (not capsule)
• Blue checkmark tint restored
• Proper .buttonBorderShape(.circle) + .tint(.blue)
• Springy animations preserved

✨ Liquid Glass Polish

• All buttons now use proper iOS 26 GlassButtonStyle
• Springy bounce animations on all close/confirm buttons
• Consistent liquid glass look across the entire app

🔧 Bug Fixes & Polish

• Fixed AI Chat not using Foundation Models (was using fallback)
• AI Chat now properly uses smartChat with conversation memory
• Fixed Tool protocol conformance for Swift 6
• Fixed AppIntents parameter types for Siri shortcuts
• Unified close button style across all views
• Minor UI improvements

🤖 Massive AI Upgrade (iOS 26)

• Smart AI Chat with conversation memory
• Tool calling - AI can access library data
• Streaming responses with typing animation
• AI-powered game recommendations
• Creative smart list generation
• Siri shortcuts: 'What should I play?'

✨ Also includes:
• Liquid Glass UI updates
• Swift 6 strict concurrency
• Improved error handling
